combo1.title: Double Machinex Pendulum Line into Deviser King Deus Machinex
combo1.description: A one-card Zero Doom Queen Machinex line that searches Dark Contract with the Gate through D/D Defense Soldier, Pendulum Summons a second Machinex alongside Vice King Requiem, and closes by Xyz Summoning Super Doom King Dark Armageddon and ranking it up into Deviser King Deus Machinex, while leaving Destiny King Zero Laplace on board.

combo2.title: Fiendsmith Engraver One-Card: Zero King Machinex into Zeus Ragnarok and Deus Machinex
combo2.description: A one-card line from Fiendsmith Engraver. The Fiendsmith engine makes Fiendsmith's Lacrima and D/D/D Wave High King Caesar, which searches Dark Contract with the Gate when it leaves the field. From there the D/D half takes over: Zero Doom Queen Machinex places Dark Contract with the Zero King, Solomon and Marksman King Tell build Abyss King Gilgamesh, and Necro Slime and Alfred make Flame King Genghis. Orthros destroys the Zero King to bring Machinex back from the Extra Deck, and Zeus Ragnarok gives you a second Pendulum Summon. End board: Zeus Ragnarok, Deviser King Deus Machinex, Wave High King Caesar with 2 materials and Cursed King Siegfried, with Count Surveyor and Savant Thomas as Pendulum Scales, Dark Contract with the Gate, and a Set Dark Contract with the Eternal Darkness. TCG note: the line runs through Spright Elf, which is Forbidden in the TCG, and uses the one copy of Fiendsmith's Lacrima that the Limited list allows. Starting hand: Fiendsmith Engraver.

cards.name: Dark Contract with the Zero King
Dark Contract with the Eternal Darkness
D/D/D Alfred the Divine Sage King

steps.text: Activate effect: Fiendsmith Engraver in your hand. Discard it to add a Fiendsmith Spell/Trap from your Deck.
Discard Fiendsmith Engraver as the cost.
Add Fiendsmith's Tract to your hand.
Activate Fiendsmith's Tract.
Add Fabled Lurrie, a LIGHT Fiend, from your Deck to your hand.
Then discard 1 card: Fabled Lurrie.
Fiendsmith's Tract resolves and goes to the Graveyard.
Activate effect: Fabled Lurrie was discarded, so it Special Summons itself.
Special Summon Fabled Lurrie.
Fabled Lurrie becomes Link Material.
Link Summon Fiendsmith's Requiem (1 LIGHT Fiend monster).
Activate effect: Fiendsmith's Requiem, a Quick Effect. Tribute it to bring a Fiendsmith monster from your hand or Deck.
Tribute Fiendsmith's Requiem as the cost.
Special Summon Lacrima the Crimson Tears from your Deck. It is always treated as a Fiendsmith card.
Activate effect: Lacrima the Crimson Tears was Special Summoned. Send a Fiendsmith card from your Deck to the Graveyard.
Send a second Fiendsmith Engraver to the Graveyard.
Activate effect: the first Fiendsmith Engraver in your Graveyard. Shuffle another LIGHT Fiend from your Graveyard into the Deck to revive it.
Shuffle Fabled Lurrie into the Deck as the cost.
Special Summon Fiendsmith Engraver.
Lacrima the Crimson Tears becomes Link Material.
Fiendsmith Engraver becomes Link Material.
Link Summon Fiendsmith's Sequence (2 monsters, including a LIGHT Fiend).
Activate effect: Fiendsmith's Sequence. Shuffle materials from your Graveyard back into your Deck and Extra Deck to bring out a Fiend from your Extra Deck.
Shuffle the second Fiendsmith Engraver from your Graveyard into the Deck as one LIGHT Fiend material.
Return Fiendsmith's Requiem from your Graveyard to the Extra Deck as the other one.
Fusion Summon Fiendsmith's Lacrima (2 LIGHT Fiend monsters). While it is face-up, your opponent's monsters lose 600 ATK.
Activate effect: Fiendsmith's Lacrima was summoned by Sequence. Target a LIGHT Fiend in your Graveyard to add to your hand or Special Summon.
Special Summon Fiendsmith Engraver from your Graveyard.
Xyz Summon D/D/D Wave High King Caesar (2 Level 6 Fiend monsters). Engraver and Fiendsmith's Lacrima are both Level 6 Fiends.
Fiendsmith Engraver becomes Xyz Material.
Fiendsmith's Lacrima becomes the second material.
Wave High King Caesar and Fiendsmith's Sequence will become Spright Elf's materials. Caesar's material Fiendsmith Engraver goes to the Graveyard with it.
Its other material, Fiendsmith's Lacrima, goes to the Graveyard too.
D/D/D Wave High King Caesar becomes Link Material.
Fiendsmith's Sequence becomes Link Material. It is the Link-2 monster Spright Elf requires.
Link Summon Spright Elf. Spright Elf is Forbidden in the TCG, so this step only works where it is allowed.
Activate effect: D/D/D Wave High King Caesar was sent from the field to the Graveyard (Chain Link 1). Add a Dark Contract card from your Deck.
Activate effect: Fiendsmith's Lacrima was sent to the Graveyard (Chain Link 2). Shuffle another LIGHT Fiend from your Graveyard into the Deck or Extra Deck to inflict 1200 damage.
Return Fiendsmith's Sequence to the Extra Deck. Your opponent takes 1200 damage.
Chain Link 1 resolves: add Dark Contract with the Gate to your hand.
Activate Dark Contract with the Gate.
Activate effect: Dark Contract with the Gate. Add a D/D monster from your Deck.
Add D/D/D Zero Doom Queen Machinex to your hand.
Activate D/D/D Zero Doom Queen Machinex as a Pendulum Scale in your left Pendulum Zone.
Activate effect: D/D/D Zero Doom Queen Machinex (Pendulum Effect). It was activated this turn, so place a Dark Contract Continuous Spell/Trap from your Deck face-up.
Place Dark Contract with the Zero King face-up on your field. It is placed, not activated, so nothing can negate it as an activation.

Activate effect: Dark Contract with the Zero King. Target Zero Doom Queen Machinex and destroy it to Special Summon a D/D monster from your Deck. For the rest of the turn, you can only Special Summon D/D monsters.
D/D/D Zero Doom Queen Machinex is destroyed and goes face-up to your Extra Deck, where its monster effect waits.
Special Summon D/D Count Surveyor from your Deck.
Activate effect: D/D Count Surveyor was Special Summoned. Add a D/D monster with 0 ATK or DEF from your Deck.
Add D/D Savant Copernicus (0 ATK / 0 DEF) to your hand.
Normal Summon D/D Savant Copernicus.
Activate effect: D/D Savant Copernicus was Normal Summoned. Send a D/D or Dark Contract card from your Deck to the Graveyard.
Send D/D Lance Soldier to the Graveyard.
Activate effect: Spright Elf, a Quick Effect. Your opponent controls no monsters, so target a Level 2 monster in your Graveyard.
Special Summon D/D Lance Soldier (Level 2).
Activate effect: D/D Lance Soldier. Target itself and raise its Level by 2, one for each Dark Contract in your field and Graveyard (the Gate and the Zero King). It is now Level 4.
Xyz Summon D/D/D Wise King Solomon (2 Level 4 D/D monsters).
D/D Lance Soldier becomes Xyz Material.
D/D Savant Copernicus becomes the second material.
Activate effect: D/D/D Wise King Solomon. Detach 1 material to add a D/D card from your Deck.
Detach D/D Lance Soldier as the cost.
Add D/D Savant Thomas to your hand.
Xyz Summon D/D/D Marksman King Tell by using Rank 4 D/D/D Wise King Solomon as its material.
D/D/D Wise King Solomon becomes Tell's material.
D/D Savant Copernicus transfers along with it.
Tell and D/D Count Surveyor will become Gilgamesh's materials. Tell's materials go to the Graveyard with it, starting with D/D Savant Copernicus.
Then D/D/D Wise King Solomon.
D/D/D Marksman King Tell becomes Link Material.
D/D Count Surveyor becomes Link Material. As a Pendulum Monster it goes face-up to the Extra Deck, not the Graveyard.
Link Summon D/D/D Abyss King Gilgamesh (2 D/D monsters) to a zone Spright Elf points to.
Activate effect: D/D/D Marksman King Tell was sent from the field to the Graveyard (Chain Link 1). Send a D/D or Dark Contract card from your Deck to the Graveyard.

Activate effect: D/D/D Abyss King Gilgamesh was Special Summoned (Chain Link 2). Place 2 D/D Pendulum Monsters with different names from your Deck in your Pendulum Zones and take 1000 damage. For the rest of the turn, you can only Special Summon D/D monsters.
Place D/D Orthros (Scale 3) in your left Pendulum Zone.
Place D/D Gryphon (Scale 1) in your right Pendulum Zone. You take 1000 damage.
Chain Link 1 resolves: send D/D Necro Slime to the Graveyard.
Activate effect: D/D Necro Slime in your Graveyard. Banish it and D/D/D Wave High King Caesar from your Graveyard as materials for a D/D/D monster.
Banish D/D Necro Slime.
Banish D/D/D Wave High King Caesar. Every D/D/D card is also a D/D card.
Fusion Summon D/D/D Alfred the Divine Sage King (2 D/D monsters).
Activate effect: D/D/D Alfred the Divine Sage King. Shuffle materials from your hand, field or banishment into the Deck to bring out another D/D/D monster from your Extra Deck.
Return D/D/D Wave High King Caesar from banishment to the Extra Deck.
Shuffle D/D Necro Slime from banishment into the Deck.
Fusion Summon D/D/D Flame King Genghis (2 D/D monsters).
Activate effect: D/D Orthros (Pendulum Effect). Target Dark Contract with the Zero King and Orthros itself, then destroy both.
D/D Orthros is destroyed and goes face-up to your Extra Deck.
Dark Contract with the Zero King is destroyed.
Activate effect: D/D/D Zero Doom Queen Machinex in your Extra Deck. A face-up Dark Contract you controlled was destroyed, so it Special Summons itself, then it can destroy 1 card on the field.
Special Summon D/D/D Zero Doom Queen Machinex.
Machinex destroys Spright Elf, clearing the Extra Monster Zone.
D/D/D Abyss King Gilgamesh becomes Link Material.
D/D/D Zero Doom Queen Machinex becomes Link Material and goes face-up to the Extra Deck.
Link Summon D/D/D Sky King Zeus Ragnarok (Link-3, 2+ D/D monsters). Its arrows point at your first three Main Monster Zones, so monsters from the face-up Extra Deck can go there.
Activate effect: D/D/D Flame King Genghis. Another D/D monster was Special Summoned, so revive a D/D monster from your Graveyard.
Special Summon D/D Savant Copernicus from your Graveyard in Defense Position. Its once-per-turn trigger was already used.
Xyz Summon a new D/D/D Wave High King Caesar (2 Level 6 Fiend monsters: Alfred and Genghis). The first three Main Monster Zones stay free for what comes next.
D/D/D Alfred the Divine Sage King becomes Xyz Material.
D/D/D Flame King Genghis becomes the second material.

Activate effect: D/D Gryphon (Pendulum Effect). Target a Fiend you control: it gains 500 ATK for each Dark Contract with a different name in your field and Graveyard (the Gate and the Zero King: +1000), then Gryphon destroys itself.
D/D Gryphon is destroyed and goes face-up to your Extra Deck.
Activate D/D Savant Thomas as a Pendulum Scale (Scale 6) in your right Pendulum Zone.
Activate effect: D/D Savant Thomas (Pendulum Effect). Add a face-up D/D Pendulum Monster from your Extra Deck to your hand.
Add D/D Count Surveyor to your hand.
Activate D/D Count Surveyor as a Pendulum Scale (Scale 1) in your left Pendulum Zone. With Scales 1 and 6, Level 2 to 5 monsters can come out.
Activate effect: D/D/D Sky King Zeus Ragnarok. Target D/D Savant Copernicus and destroy it. This turn you can also Pendulum-summon D/D monsters a second time.
D/D Savant Copernicus is destroyed and goes face-up to your Extra Deck.
Pendulum Summon D/D Savant Copernicus from your face-up Extra Deck in Defense Position.
Pendulum Summon D/D Orthros in the same Pendulum Summon.
Pendulum Summon D/D Gryphon in the same Pendulum Summon.
D/D Orthros, a Tuner, becomes Synchro Material and goes face-up to the Extra Deck.
D/D Gryphon becomes Synchro Material and goes face-up to the Extra Deck.
Synchro Summon D/D/D Cursed King Siegfried (Level 4 Tuner + Level 4 D/D).
Pendulum Summon D/D Orthros again, with the extra Pendulum Summon from Zeus Ragnarok.
Pendulum Summon D/D Gryphon in that same Pendulum Summon.
Xyz Summon D/D/D Wave King Caesar (2 Level 4 Fiend monsters). Every Main Monster Zone is full, so it takes Copernicus's zone.
D/D Savant Copernicus becomes Xyz Material.
D/D Orthros becomes the second material.

Wave King Caesar and D/D Gryphon will become Gilgamesh's materials. Caesar's material D/D Savant Copernicus goes to the Graveyard: Xyz Materials are not on the field, so a Pendulum Monster among them doesn't go to the Extra Deck.
D/D Orthros goes to the Graveyard too.
D/D/D Wave King Caesar becomes Link Material.
D/D Gryphon becomes Link Material and goes face-up to the Extra Deck.
Link Summon a second D/D/D Abyss King Gilgamesh. Its effect is once per turn and has already been used, so it is just a D/D/D body.
Activate effect: D/D/D Wave King Caesar was sent from the field to the Graveyard. Add a Dark Contract card from your Deck.
Add Dark Contract with the Eternal Darkness to your hand.
Xyz Summon D/D/D Deviser King Deus Machinex by using a D/D/D monster you control as its material: the second Gilgamesh.
D/D/D Abyss King Gilgamesh becomes its material.

Set Dark Contract with the Eternal Darkness. End board: Zeus Ragnarok (negates a hand-trap effect), Deus Machinex, Wave High King Caesar (negates a summoning effect) and Cursed King Siegfried (negates a face-up Spell/Trap), with Count Surveyor and Savant Thomas in the Pendulum Zones, so Eternal Darkness is active from your opponent's turn.

combo3.title: Machinex Pendulum Loop Setup
combo3.description: A solid sequence setting up strong Pendulum scales using Zero Doom Queen Machinex and Dark Contract with the Gate. By utilizing D/D Defense Soldier and linking into Abyss King Gilgamesh, you establish a loop with Vice King Requiem and Destiny King Zero Laplace. The combo finishes by climbing into Super Doom King Dark Armageddon and ultimately Deviser King Deus Machinex.
